jobQuery: select j.id,j.organization_id,j.audience,j.export_type,j.status,j.scope,j.row_count,j.byte_size,j.file_name,j.created_at,j.started_at,j.finalized_at,j.error_message,j.data_version,s.id snapshot_id,s.status snapshot_status from public.app_export_jobs j left join export_snapshot_private.snapshots s on s.job_id=j.id where j.id='78a43447-1b39-4f51-9e76-0da0df8b9bb4';

download.reader: Bundled Python standard-library streaming ZIP/XML; no workbook edits or floating-point pricing comparisons

source.query:
with job as materialized(select * from public.app_export_jobs where id='78a43447-1b39-4f51-9e76-0da0df8b9bb4'),
  legacy as materialized(select public.normalize_catalog_product_code(sp.product_code) collate "C" code,sp.supplier_id,sp.id::text source_id,sp.buy_price,sp.valid_from from public.supplier_prices sp cross join job j where sp.organization_id=j.organization_id and sp.brand_id=(j.scope->>'brandId')::uuid and sp.is_active and sp.buy_price>0 and sp.currency='EUR' and sp.valid_from<=current_date and (sp.valid_to is null or sp.valid_to>=current_date) and public.normalize_catalog_product_code(sp.product_code) ~ '[A-Z0-9]' and not exists(select 1 from public.supplier_current_price_pointers ptr where ptr.organization_id=sp.organization_id and ptr.brand_id=sp.brand_id and ptr.supplier_id=sp.supplier_id)),
  latest as materialized(select distinct on(code,supplier_id) * from legacy order by code,supplier_id,valid_from desc,source_id desc),
  winners as materialized(select distinct on(code) * from latest order by code,buy_price,valid_from desc,supplier_id),
  snapshot_rows as materialized(select r.* from export_snapshot_private.rows r where r.snapshot_id='ade822c3-e5ba-4f90-bb99-ef4b758a24d2'),
  checked as(select p.*,w.buy_price,w.valid_from,j.scope,md5((select string_agg(octet_length(v)::text||':'||v,'' order by ord) from unnest(array[coalesce(payload->>'code',''),coalesce(payload->>'description',''),trim_scale((payload->>'price')::numeric)::text,coalesce(payload->>'priceDate',''),case when payload->>'discontinued'='true' then 'Discontinued'||case when coalesce(payload->>'replacementCode','')<>'' then '; replacement: '||(payload->>'replacementCode') else '' end else 'Active' end]) with ordinality f(v,ord))) row_hash from snapshot_rows p cross join job j left join winners w on w.code=p.source_key)
  select clock_timestamp() observed_at,count(*) row_count,md5(string_agg(row_hash,'' order by ordinal)) ordered_fields_md5,count(*) filter(where payload->>'brand' is distinct from scope->>'brandName' or payload->>'currency' is distinct from 'EUR') scope_mismatches,count(*) filter(where buy_price is null) missing_prices,count(*) filter(where (payload->>'price')::numeric is distinct from round(buy_price*(1+(scope->>'marginPercent')::numeric),2)) price_mismatches,count(*) filter(where payload->>'priceDate' is distinct from valid_from::text) date_mismatches,(select count(*) from winners) eligible_source_keys,(select count(*) from public.supplier_current_price_pointers ptr cross join job j where ptr.organization_id=j.organization_id and ptr.brand_id=(j.scope->>'brandId')::uuid) pointer_count,(select public.get_admin_price_list_export_version(j.organization_id,(j.scope->>'brandId')::uuid) from job j) current_data_version from checked;
